hostRequirements.headlessDefinition: Headless means unattended: no prompt, no window to focus, no person driving the IDE. It does not mean Visual Studio is absent. Generation always runs through the T4 tooling of the resolved Visual Studio installation (embedded devenv.exe automation session); a plain build never substitutes for transformation.
